# Livebook example software

The Livebooks and example tests use these Prolog programs. Their licenses
apply to the example sources, including copies embedded in the Livebooks.

- [leanCoP 2.1(b)](https://www.leancop.de/leancopS.html#leancop21), by Jens Otten.
  GNU GPL, version unspecified in the sources. See [COPYING](COPYING).
- [leanHaT 1.0](https://leancop.de/leanhat/programs/leanHaT.tar.gz) and
  [ileanCoP 1.0](https://www.leancop.de/ileancop/), by Jens Otten.
  GNU GPL, version unspecified in the sources. See [COPYING](COPYING).
- [Metagol](https://github.com/metagol/metagol/tree/7b617992d30d3cee37a6f4bb8667f717a46cc6a3),
  by Andrew Cropper and Stephen H. Muggleton. [BSD-3-Clause](metagol/LICENSE).
- [Aleph](https://github.com/friguzzi/aleph/tree/cc6ef273dc270a8a26a078ad6e90db1ba1fe31ef),
  by Ashwin Srinivasan, SWI module by Fabrizio Riguzzi and Paolo Niccolò Giubelli.
  The [source notice](aleph/aleph.pl) permits academic use and asks commercial
  users to contact Srinivasan.
